abstract: Hydatidiform mole (HM) is the most common form of gestational trophoblastic neoplasia. Recurrence of HM is extremely rare. Here, we report the case of a patient with six consecutive partial HMs without normal pregnancy. A 42-year-old lady who was referred to us at King Fahad Hospital of the University, Al Khobar, initially as a case of 26-year-old with persistent trophoblastic disease after three recurrent molar pregnancies that were confirmed histologically in the referring hospital. She underwent evacuation and curettage and was followed up by serial β-human chorionic gonadotropin levels, and did not require chemotherapy. She then had three more molar pregnancies in 1995, 1996, and 2004; all molar pregnancies were evacuated by suction curettage at her base hospital, but in the last event, she complained of shortness of breath and abdominal pain. Diagnostic workup in our hospital confirmed choriocarcinoma, for which she received multiple regimen chemotherapy and was cured. Unfortunately, she lately presented with symptoms suggestive of premature menopause.
abstract_ja: 胞状奇胎(HM)は妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の最も一般的な形態である。胞状奇胎の再発は極めて稀である。ここでは、正常妊娠を経ずに連続6回の部分胞状奇胎妊娠を経験した患者を報告する。当院には、紹介元で組織学的に確認された3回の反復性胞状奇胎妊娠後の持続性栄養膜疾患として、当初26歳の症例として紹介された42歳女性が受診した。彼女は掻爬術を受け、連続的なβ-ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)値によりフォローアップされ、化学療法は必要なかった。その後1995年、1996年、2004年にさらに3回の胞状奇胎妊娠を経験し、いずれも紹介元病院で吸引掻爬術により排出された。最後の妊娠時には、呼吸困難と腹痛を訴えた。当院での診断的精査により絨毛癌と確認され、多剤併用化学療法を受けて治癒した。その後、早発閉経を示唆する症状が出現した。
